thread:
Ava Li: Hey team — Jigsaw Systems sent over their assets for the co-branded solution pack. Dropping the list here and a quick ask: can design + legal review and we get a final pass today? :pray:

Ava Li: Files linked: `jigsaw_logo.zip` (svg/png/eps), `jigsaw_brand_guidelines.pdf`, `customer_case_v1.docx`, `onepager_jigsaw_redwood_v1.pdf`

Samir Patel: Thanks. Quick Q — do we have the co-brand lockup spec from Jigsaw or are we applying our default lockup?

Noah Chen: They included a lockup mock in the PDF. It looks tight on spacing. I'll pull the svg and propose a 10% clearspace increase.

Jamie Brooks: Legal flag — their brand guidelines call out use-cases that require partner sign-off for customer logos in case studies. Need confirmation from their PM that customers gave permission.

Ava Li: @Jamie Brooks noted. I'll ping their PM for written sign-off and ask for an explicit permission line.

marketing-bot: Checklist reminder:
• Logo formats: SVG (clean), PNG 2x, EPS — present
• Clearspace & min-size included? — check
• Trademark lockup usage noted — yes
• Case study release ok? — pending partner sign-off

Samir Patel: For the one-pager: can we shorten the tech section? The current draft is a wall of text about routing policies. Suggest bullets: "low-latency routing", "model fallback" and a simple diagram.

Noah Chen: I'll draft new layout. Proposed copy snippets:
```
- Low-latency smart routing across regions
- Predictable throughput with dedicated capacity
- Secure private deployments (VPC & on-prem)
```

Ava Li: Perfect. Also, Jigsaw asked for a 2-week turnaround on the public launch. We should confirm the marketplace asset (metadata + logo) and the solution brief timeline.

Jamie Brooks: Timeline OK assuming we get customer permissions within 48 hours. Also need to embargo launch assets until partner legal confirms co-marketing wording.

Samir Patel: Design note — can we get a 300x75 png for the marketplace listing? They typically need a wide logo. Also need a monochrome variant for dark UI.

Noah Chen: Will export `jigsaw_logo_300x75.png` and `jigsaw_logo_mono.svg`. Linking once done.

Ava Li: Action items summarized:
- Ava: request written customer permissions from Jigsaw PM (today)
- Jamie: prepare legal checklist for co-marketing (today)
- Noah: update one-pager layout + export marketplace logos (EOD)
- Samir: final copy edits for solution brief (EOD)

marketing-bot: Status tag: `in_progress` — please update thread when items done.

Samir Patel: Quick approval if legal and partner confirm — I'll sign off on copy. :thumbsup:

Noah Chen: Uploaded `jigsaw_logo_300x75.png` and `jigsaw_logo_mono.svg` to the shared drive: drive.redwood.co/jigsaw/assets

Ava Li: Partner PM replied: "We have written permission from two customers listed in the case study; internal legal gave ok." Forwarded the confirmation to @Jamie Brooks.

Jamie Brooks: Got it. Requested minor wording change in the case study to avoid naming an unreleased feature. Please update `customer_case_v1.docx` accordingly.

Samir Patel: Updated the brief copy and replaced the feature reference with a capability statement. Uploaded `onepager_jigsaw_redwood_v2.pdf`.

Ava Li: Great — with legal wording and updated assets, I'm green to schedule the marketplace publish for next Tuesday. Anyone object?

Noah Chen: No objections from design.

Jamie Brooks: No objections from legal. Confirm embargo lift on Tuesday 09:00 PT.

Samir Patel: Scheduling done — added to calendar and notified the GTM channel. :white_check_mark:

Ava Li: Thanks y'all — closing this thread once marketplace listing is live.

marketing-bot: Final status: `approved_for_publish` — embargo lift 2029-04-09 09:00 PT."
